name: Checkout Progress Indicator
summary: Passive checkout-context profile of canonical Steps with a required accessible name, target-supplied completed/current/upcoming stages, intrinsic narrow stacking, and no implicit checkout state or navigation.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Passive checkout-context wrapper that establishes the named inline-size container and adds no independent list or workflow semantics.

anatomy.name: orderedList
anatomy.description: Required canonical ol.steps sequence carrying the non-empty accessible checkout-progress name.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated canonical Steps list item preserving target-supplied checkout order.

anatomy.name: connector
anatomy.description: Canonical decorative connector shown by the wide Steps profile and intentionally hidden by P4's narrow stacked profile.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Canonical visible step number, completion check, or equivalent non-color cue.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Canonical wrapper for the visible title and optional description or status text.

anatomy.name: state
anatomy.description: Canonical visible or visually hidden status text required to expose completed meaning when the check is decorative.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Steps sizing with a private P4 container threshold for connector-free narrow stacking.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid passive checkout profile containing a labelled non-empty canonical Steps sequence.

states.name: upcoming
states.description: Canonical default Steps item without completed or current state.

states.name: completed
states.description: Canonical completed item with a visible non-color cue and equivalent status text.

states.name: current
states.description: At most one canonical current item projected from target-owned checkout truth.

states.name: narrow
states.description: Private container-driven stacked profile that hides decorative connectors and preserves canonical item content in source order.

behavior.name: stepsComposition
behavior.description: Checkout Progress consumes canonical Steps anatomy, status presentation, horizontal geometry, forced-colors treatment and zero-runtime behavior instead of recreating a second stepper.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Omit the complete profile when the accessible label is empty or the ordered step slot has no content; never emit an empty wrapper or unnamed ordered list.

behavior.name: orderedSequence
behavior.description: Target-supplied stages remain in meaningful checkout order across horizontal, stacked, localized and RTL layouts.

behavior.name: stepStatus
behavior.description: Targets project upcoming, completed and current state. At most one item uses aria-current="step" and completion has text plus a visible cue rather than color alone.

behavior.name: passiveByDefault
behavior.description: P4 creates no focus stops, links, buttons, keyboard model, route behavior, validation gate, visited state, persistence, announcement or checkout-state synchronization.

behavior.name: targetOwnedLifecycle
behavior.description: The target owns stage labels/count/status, page title and heading, checkout data, saving, validation, availability, routing, history, focus, errors, announcements and analytics.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: P4 uses one named inline-size container; wide mode retains canonical horizontal Steps and narrow mode stacks items without private Steps geometry, viewport assumptions, CSS reordering or Studio-only rules.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Non-empty localized accessible name for the canonical ordered checkout-stage list.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: Non-empty target-owned ordered canonical Steps composition containing localized titles, optional descriptions and upcoming/completed/current status projection.

accessibility: Render a non-empty labelled canonical ordered Steps list and omit the complete P4 profile when its accessible name or ordered content is absent.
Mark at most one current item with aria-current="step" and do not add a custom Step role, aria-orientation, selected, checked or progressbar semantics.
Expose completed meaning through equivalent state text and a visible check or other non-color cue; keep the icon itself decorative.
Keep every checkout-stage title visible and in source order across wide, narrow, localized, RTL, zoomed and forced-colors modes.
Keep P4 passive. Compose native canonical Links or Buttons only after a target explicitly owns saved data, navigation availability, routing, validation, focus, error and announcement behavior.
Repeat current-stage progress in the page title or primary heading when the host is a multi-page checkout; P4 does not replace that page-level context.

web.notes: Passive wrapper consumes canonical Steps DOM, styles and status behavior; P4 adds only intrinsic narrow checkout layout and zero runtime.

shopify.notes: Native checkout requires an approved Checkout UI Extension target and supported Shopify components/data. Theme Liquid cannot own or copy this neutral checkout DOM/CSS.
